Plenary Session 1: The Natural Gas Sector: Future Outlook
events.blurb:
Chairman: Adv. Amit Krispin
The session will address the tension between domestic demand and exports, between supply and infrastructure, and between energy security and the promotion of competition and efficiency. We will examine whether future supply will be sufficient, what the allocation of resources will look like in the coming years, and whether a dedicated regulatory framework is required for high-capacity consumers. Participants in the discussion include:
Daniel Padon, Energy Coordinator at the Ministry of Finance’s Budget Department; Chen Bar-Yosef, Director of the Natural Resources Administration at the Ministry of Energy; Igor Aharonovich, VP of Trade at Noga;
Saar Parag, Deputy CEO and Commercial Director at New-Med Energy; Yaron Ronai, Head of the Fuels Unit at the Israel Electric Corporation
